summary: The Generation Essentials Group (TGE) filed a Form 6-K announcing a share repurchase program of up to US$10 million of its ordinary shares, approved by its Board. Repurchases may occur in open market, privately negotiated, or block trades under Rule 10b-18/10b5-1. Concurrently, controlling shareholder AMTD Digital Inc., directors, and management voluntarily agreed to a two-year lock-up on their TGE shares. TGE cites a 17.7% increase in total asset value to ~$1.7B and a 15.8% rise in net assets to ~$971M, viewing shares as undervalued. The repurchase aims to enhance shareholder value. Watch for execution pace and market conditions.
